title: Landscape plan by a competent landscape designer with species list and irrigation plan
text: Submission of a landscape plan prepared by a competent landscape designer. This is to include a species list and irrigation plan demonstrating achievement of Waterwise design principles.
notes: from: ch4p1 C1.2.8 (landscaping plan provided); diverges: this A names the preparer and requires a species list and irrigation plan. landscape.plan_provided is true only where the plan is prepared by a competent landscape designer and includes both; whether it demonstrates Waterwise design principles is for the assessor against O4.12.3.
